# netbox_location (Data Source)

A NetBox location within a site (dcim.location).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/location/):

> Racks and devices can be grouped by location within a site. A location may represent a floor, room, cage, or similar organizational unit. Locations can be nested to form a hierarchy. For example, you may have floors within a site, and rooms within a floor.

Each location must have a name that is unique within its parent site and location, if any.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_location" "test" {
  name = "test-location"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id of the location.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent location.
- `site` (String) Slug of the site.
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site the location belongs to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: planned, staging, active, decommissioning, retired.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `tenant_slug` (String) Slug of the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `depth` (Number) Nesting depth within the site.
- `description` (String)
- `device_count` (Number) Number of devices in the location.
- `facility` (String) Local facility ID or description.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `prefix_count` (Number) Number of prefixes in the location.
- `rack_count` (Number) Number of racks in the location.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
